content:
I read the direct run (model allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base, revision a347b15, 2023 imagery; 128x128 = 16,384 windows, all valid, no no-data) into a scores file, then ran the review-set ranker over it at a 5% budget.

**Which windows first:** the 819 windows with the smallest top-1 minus top-2 logit margin (the package's per-window confidence; lower = the model is least decided between two classes = most suspect). Full ordered list saved at `review_list_49faf61fce.csv` in the run workspace. Top 5:

| Rank | Window | Row, Col | Predicted class | Margin | Boundary neighbours |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1821 | 14, 29 | woodland_forest | 0.108 | 4 |
| 2 | 1321 | 10, 41 | montane_forest | 0.149 | 3 |
| 3 | 3037 | 23, 93 | shrubland_savanna | 0.153 | 6 |
| 4 | 907 | 7, 11 | woodland_forest | 0.162 | 8 |
| 5 | 1797 | 14, 5 | montane_forest | 0.176 | 7 |

**Why these, in short:**
- Their margins (0.108-0.994 across the whole set) sit far below the map-wide median of 4.468, so the model is least decisive exactly there - those are the decisions worth human eyes first.
- Most sit on predicted-class boundaries (boundary_neighbours counts neighbour windows with a different predicted class; that is where mislabels tend to live).
- Class mix of the 819: grassland_barren 31.3%, shrubland_savanna 30.0%, woodland_forest 15.3%, montane_forest 10.3%, urban_dense_development 6.5%, agriculture_settlement 3.7%, herbaceous_wetland 3.1%.

**Two caveats to state honestly:**
- A low margin ranks relative suspicion; it is not a probability of error, so none of these can be called "probably wrong" until labelled.
- This ranking used the logit margin; on Ai2's suite, one-minus-top-probability ranked errors better than the logit margin on 14 of 16 multi-class tasks - worth re-running with that form if you want the strongest ordering.

**Suggested next steps:** (1) plan a label sample with olmoearth_plan_label_sample (passing this scores file) to get an honest error-rate estimate with its interval; (2) compare against a second inference over the same windows with olmoearth_compare_review if another run exists. Want me to set up either?
